candidates.name: Tink AB
candidates.description: Tink provides an open banking platform with extensive connectivity to European financial institutions similar to Plaid's core data aggregation service.
candidates.rationale: Tink’s open-banking APIs and financial-account connectivity directly overlap Plaid’s data aggregation offering and serve the same fintech developers and institutions.

candidates.name: TrueLayer
candidates.description: TrueLayer operates an open banking network that facilitates secure account access and payments, mirroring Plaid's functionality.
candidates.rationale: TrueLayer provides open-banking APIs for account-data access and payments, directly overlapping Plaid’s offering and serving the same fintech developers and businesses.

candidates.name: Galileo Financial Technologies, LLC
candidates.description: Galileo offers a financial technology platform that provides APIs for banking and payments, enabling companies to build fintech solutions.
candidates.rationale: Galileo focuses on card issuing, payment processing, and banking infrastructure, not Plaid’s bank-account data connectivity and aggregation job.

candidates.name: Moov Financial, Inc.
candidates.description: Moov provides a comprehensive payments platform via API, allowing developers to integrate money movement services similarly to Plaid's payment APIs.
candidates.rationale: Both provide developer-focused financial APIs enabling bank-connected payments and money movement, serving fintech teams building embedded financial products.

candidates.name: Yodlee, Inc.
candidates.description: Yodlee is a direct competitor in the financial data aggregation space, providing APIs to connect and analyze consumer-permissioned financial data.
candidates.rationale: Yodlee offers competing financial-data aggregation APIs connecting applications to consumer-permissioned banking data, serving the same fintech developers and institutions.

candidates.name: MX
candidates.description: MX specializes in consumer-permissioned financial data aggregation and analytics, helping fintechs and financial institutions build better user experiences.
candidates.rationale: MX and Plaid both provide consumer-permissioned financial data aggregation and APIs to fintechs and financial institutions for connected financial experiences.

candidates.name: Salt Edge Inc.
candidates.description: Salt Edge provides a global open banking gateway for data aggregation and payment initiation, directly competing with Plaid's service portfolio.
candidates.rationale: Salt Edge offers open-banking APIs for account-data aggregation and payment initiation, serving the same fintech developers and financial institutions as Plaid.

candidates.name: Yapily Ltd
candidates.description: Yapily offers an open banking API platform that enables developers to access financial data and initiate payments, mirroring Plaid's core offering.
candidates.rationale: Yapily and Plaid both provide open-banking APIs for account-data access and payment initiation to developers and financial applications.

candidates.name: Flinks Technology Inc.
candidates.description: Flinks provides an embedded finance platform that unifies financial data connectivity and payment initiation for fintech applications.
candidates.rationale: Flinks offers financial-data connectivity and payment APIs for fintech applications, closely matching Plaid’s core offering and buyer persona.

candidates.name: Belvo Tecnologias LTDA.
candidates.description: Belvo is an open finance platform that provides APIs for data aggregation and payments, serving as the functional equivalent to Plaid in Latin American markets.
candidates.rationale: Belvo offers open-finance APIs for account-data aggregation and payments, serving the same fintech developers and institutions as Plaid.

candidates.name: Akoya LLC
candidates.description: Akoya provides a secure API-based network for financial data sharing between institutions and fintech apps, focusing on the same data aggregation space.
candidates.rationale: Akoya offers a competing API network connecting financial institutions and fintech applications for secure financial-data access and sharing.

candidates.name: Thisisbud
candidates.description: Bud provides tools for financial institutions to access and enrich transactional data through open banking connectivity.
candidates.rationale: Both provide open-banking connectivity and transaction-data enrichment tools for financial applications and institutions serving similar integration needs.

candidates.name: Brankas Pte. Ltd.
candidates.description: Brankas is an open finance technology provider that offers APIs for banking data and payment integration across Southeast Asia.
candidates.rationale: Brankas offers open-finance APIs for bank-data connectivity and payments, serving the same application developers and financial institutions as Plaid.

candidates.name: leantech.me
candidates.description: Lean Technologies provides financial infrastructure for data aggregation and payments in the Middle East, functioning as a regional peer to Plaid.
candidates.rationale: Lean offers bank-data aggregation and payment APIs, serving the same fintech developers and financial institutions as Plaid.

candidates.name: Fabrick S.p.A.
candidates.description: Fabrick enables open banking and payment services, allowing businesses to integrate financial features through a unified API platform.
candidates.rationale: Fabrick’s unified APIs for open banking, payments, and embedded financial services overlap Plaid’s bank-data connectivity platform and target similar fintech developers and businesses.

candidates.name: Setu by Pine Labs
candidates.description: Setu provides an API-first approach to financial services in India, enabling data access and payment initiation for developers.
candidates.rationale: Setu offers developer APIs for financial-data access and payment initiation, closely matching Plaid’s bank-connectivity platform and fintech buyer persona.

candidates.name: Stripe, Inc.
candidates.description: Stripe provides broad financial infrastructure that includes payment processing and bank account connectivity APIs which overlap with Plaid's ecosystem.
candidates.rationale: Both offer APIs for financial applications to connect bank accounts and facilitate account-based payment workflows, targeting fintech product and engineering teams.

candidates.name: Dwolla
candidates.description: Dwolla provides a sophisticated API layer for bank transfers and payment orchestration, competing in the infrastructure space for fintechs.
candidates.rationale: Both provide APIs enabling fintech applications to connect bank accounts and facilitate bank-based payment workflows for developers and product teams.

candidates.name: Unit
candidates.description: Unit is a banking-as-a-service platform that helps software companies embed financial features like accounts and payments into their applications.
candidates.rationale: Unit provides embedded banking infrastructure, while Plaid primarily connects apps to existing bank-account data; their products are complementary, not substitutes for one job.

candidates.name: swan.io
candidates.description: Swan provides an API-based platform to embed banking services, including accounts and cards, into non-financial applications.
candidates.rationale: Swan provides embedded banking infrastructure for accounts and cards, while Plaid primarily provides bank-data connectivity; their core jobs-to-be-done differ.

candidates.name: Modulr Finance Limited
candidates.description: Modulr offers a payments automation platform that provides APIs for managing financial operations and bank-grade connectivity.
candidates.rationale: Modulr provides payment execution and financial-operations infrastructure, not Plaid’s core bank-account data aggregation and connectivity job.

candidates.name: Marqeta, Inc.
candidates.description: Marqeta provides a modern card issuing platform via APIs, allowing businesses to create and manage payment cards through developer-focused infrastructure.
candidates.rationale: Marqeta’s card-issuing infrastructure serves fintech developers but does not overlap Plaid’s bank-account connectivity and financial-data aggregation job.

candidates.name: Finzly, Inc.
candidates.description: Finzly provides a modular platform for banks to handle payments and embedded finance, serving similar infrastructure needs as Plaid's network.
candidates.rationale: Finzly provides banks payment-processing infrastructure, while Plaid provides applications bank-account data connectivity; their core jobs and primary buyers differ.

candidates.name: Form3 Group
candidates.description: Form3 provides cloud-native payment technology via API, focusing on the infrastructure layer that enables financial institutions to move money.
candidates.rationale: Form3 provides payment-processing infrastructure, while Plaid primarily provides bank-account connectivity and financial-data APIs; buyers use them for distinct jobs.

candidates.name: Rapyd
candidates.description: Rapyd operates a global fintech-as-a-service platform that offers local payment methods and financial data connectivity APIs for developers.
candidates.rationale: Both provide developer APIs for financial-data connectivity and embedded payment capabilities, serving fintechs integrating bank accounts and local payment rails.
